name: Bank7 Corp.
summary: Bank7 Corp. operates as a bank holding company for Bank7 that provides banking and financial services to individual and corporate customers. It provides commercial deposit, commercial checking, money market, and other deposit accounts; and retail deposit services, such as certificates of deposit, money market accounts, checking accounts, negotiable order of withdrawal accounts, savings accounts, and automated teller machine access.
